s.t:
Our mission is to improve the performance of athletes and teams, which we do by engineering the premier technology platform for sport. We've been at the forefront of sports technology and science since 2006 - we don't just work in the sporting industry, we are actively changing its future. Our solutions are designed to help athletes and coaches "play smart" in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.
We work with over 4,600 teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.

Our solutions include wearable technology, video analytics, and athlete monitoring solutions, and we are passionate about helping sports organizations at all levels to better scout, recruit, teach, and win.
WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT STATE-OF-THE-ART TECHNOLOGY
We are looking for a talented Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with a drive to build quality products.
This role offers the opportunity to contribute across multiple applications and throughout the entire technology stack, from databases and backend services to APIs and front-end development.
Based in Cologne, you will be a key player in the Engineering team working on the IMPECT family of applications. You'll contribute to IMPECT's internal services that power our data ecosystem, sourcing and managing data from external providers, ingesting and recording video content, and enabling large-scale event collection and annotation.

You'll also help build and evolve the systems that support our data collection workforce, including tools for task assignment, progress tracking, deadline management, quality assurance, and accurate compensation.

In addition, you'll develop database-driven tools that ensure consistency and detect anomalies, safeguarding data quality when integrating multiple data sources. IMPECT's applications are written in modern frameworks and provide exciting challenges.

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll be part of a highly motivated team building and evolving the core services that power our data collection platform, forming the foundation for the applications we deliver to our customers.
We believe that our customers deserve to have the leading technology, and we are on a mission to make the best possible products to enhance their performance. Our engineers drive this ethos by making sure all of this technology comes together in a way our customers love to use.

Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
Build and maintain Angular web applications
Build and maintain Java Spring Boot APIs and backend services that power our applications
Design and implement database schema
Profile and optimize query performance in backend applications
Engage in architectural discussions to help design scalable and resilient systems.
Work directly with Product and Design on scoping and designing features
Work in multidisciplinary teams and interface with other engineers in our team and across various domains.
Document your work in a shared knowledge base platform.

At least 5 years of software development experience.
Demonstrated experience programming in Typescript, Javascript, and Angular
Demonstrated experience programming in Kotlin or Java.
Demonstrated experience working in SQL and designing database schema
Ability to reason about and debug complex systems and applications
Experience with Git code management is highly desired.

Very strong attention to detail.
Proven self-starter.
Ability to communicate well, both verbally and in writing.
Ability to prioritise and a "can-do" attitude.
Occasionally providing technical assistance to our customer support team

We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.
We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication in order to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.
Our workforce spans more than 20 countries, you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures, and build your global awareness and capability
We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better. There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.
Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet!
Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch!

We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.
All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

What makes us unique? A mission-driven culture where performance meets impact. Our innovative campus brings together tech talent, professional athletes, students, and artists, creating an ecosystem where digital innovation drives both business growth and positive change.
We have reached this scale by staying fully independent, fully profitable, and achieving double-digit growth.
We're now at an inflection point, upgrading our entire technical foundation with cloud architecture, AI, and real-time systems to become a global reference for luxury travel — known by travelers for its excellent offer and customer experience, and by our providers as a high-performance business development partner.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

Starshield leverages SpaceX’s Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads. The Starshield team is building highly reliable in-space mesh networks, designing secure systems to guarantee access to space, designing next-gen communication and sensing software, and more.

As a Sr. AI Security Software Engineer, you will leverage AI to automate security-related efforts and ensure safe AI integration into new and existing systems. If you are passionate about AI, security, and pushing the limits of combining both together, this role is for you.

s.h: Ideally, you have notable skills in the following
s.t:
Software engineering
Agent engineering and security
LLM attack surfaces
Network and operating system security
Incident response and adversary detection

Being flexible, communicating clearly, and establishing and maintaining productive working relationships with other engineering teams are paramount to success. If you are passionate about building quality products, love the challenges of outsmarting adversaries, and want to make an impact on an inter-planetary scale, then you will fit right in.

Design and build security-critical agents for Starshield that automate network and systems defense
Leverage AI to discover and fix security issues in Starshield infrastructure and systems
Provide guidance and perform testing of AI integrations into new and existing Starshield systems
Identify new areas of the program where meaningful security improvements can be gained via automation and AI
Maintain existing production systems and improve security posture via both direct implementation and recommendations to other teams

Bachelor's degree in computer science or another STEM discipline AND 5+ years of professional experience in security software development; OR 7+ years of professional experience in security software development in lieu of a degree
Experience with one or more software development languages (i.e. Python, C++, Golang)
Experience designing and implementing security solutions for operating systems, distributed systems, or other enterprise/large-scale infrastructure
Experience designing and implementing solutions with LLMs, LLM-based agents, or other AI topics

Demonstrated ability to deal with ambiguity, learn quickly, problem solve, and take ownership of the end result
Understanding of core security engineering topics: cryptography, authentication, network security, operating system security
Experience designing, prompting, and securing agents that can perform long-running autonomous tasks
Experience red-teaming/penetration-testing LLMs, including prompt injection, jailbreaking, and data exfiltration
Experience deploying and managing LLMs, including infrastructure and maintenance to ensure reliable, scalable operation
Experience contributing security improvements to complex systems
Flexibility, communicating clearly, and establishing and maintaining productive working relationships with other engineering teams
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
Ability to work both independently and in a team
Advanced degree in a technical or engineering discipline
Active Top Secret, Top Secret SCI, or DOE Level Q clearance

About Us We are an engineering driven company building best in class durability simulation software used to solve complex, real world problems. Our products are developed using a modern technology stack with heavy automation, CI/CD , and a strong emphasis on testing and software quality .

We care deeply about how software is built, not just that it works. Good design, maintainability, leveraging new tools and technology (AI) testability, and long-term sustainability are central to everything we do. The Role We are looking for a Senior Frontend Developer to join our team and help build and evolve our React based user interfaces.

This role is not about being the “smartest person in the room”, but about being a strong, proactive team contributor who raises the quality of the whole group.

You will work closely with the Senior Developer leading the front end, contributing ideas, challenging assumptions constructively, and helping turn complex requirements into robust, user-friendly solutions. What We Value Most 1.

Team player with a positive working attitude You collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and treat colleagues with respect. You care about the success of the team, not just your own output. You give and receive feedback constructively and contribute to a healthy engineering culture. 2.

Works well with front‑end technical leadership You are comfortable working alongside the Senior Developer leading the front end. You can follow an agreed technical direction while contributing ideas and improvements. You know when to lead, when to support, and when to challenge — always in a professional, solution focused way. 3.

Takes initiative and ownership You actively look for problems before they become issues. You propose solutions, improvements, and refactoring rather than waiting to be asked. 4. Strong technical skill and general problem solving ability You have solid experience building applications with React and Redux (or similar state management).

You write clean, maintainable, well-tested code. You can reason about complex systems and make pragmatic trade-offs. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain front‑end features using React and Redux. Collaborate closely with front‑end leadership, back‑end engineers, and other stakeholders.

Contribute to code reviews with a focus on quality, maintainability, and consistency. Ensure front‑end code is well tested and fits into our automated CI/CD pipelines. Identify opportunities to improve tooling, performance, reliability, and developer experience. Help uphold and evolve front‑end standards and best practices.

What We’re Looking For Strong experience with modern TypeScript , React, and Redux. A quality focused mindset: testing, code reviews, and good design matter to you. Experience working in teams that value automation and continuous integration. Confidence to take initiative without ego.

Curiosity, adaptability, and strong general problem solving skills. Experience with automated testing (unit, integration, UI). Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern build tooling. Nice to Have Experience working on technically complex or engineering heavy products.

enyo baut das Energiemanagement fürs Zuhause. Ein Gerät, das im Haus steht und PV-Anlage, Batteriespeicher, Wärmepumpe und Wallbox miteinander verbindet, unabhängig davon, von welchem Hersteller sie sind. Es entscheidet laufend, welches Gerät wann wie viel Strom bekommt: Speicher laden, wenn Sonne da ist oder der Strom günstig ist, Wärmepumpe hochfahren, wenn es sich lohnt. Der Kunde steckt das Gerät an und muss sich um nichts weiter kümmern.
Der schwierige Teil daran: Jeder Hersteller spricht sein eigenes Protokoll und alles muss zuverlässig und lokal auf einem kleinen Gerät laufen. Genau daran arbeitest du.
Als Founding Engineer arbeitest du direkt mit unserem CTO an Architektur und technischer Ausrichtung und baust App, Plattform und Energy Apps von Zero to One.
Die Rolle ist in Köln, hybrid mit 3 Tagen pro Woche im Büro.
Aufgaben
Architektur und Vision: Du prägst die technologische Ausrichtung von enyo und baust das Herzstück unseres Systems - App, Plattform, Energy Apps - von Grund auf.
Plattform und Firmware: Du entwickelst eine skalierbare, wartbare API sowie SDKs und programmierst die Intelligenz direkt auf der enyo Box (lokales Processing, Edge Computing, Hardware-Nähe).
Hardware-Integration: Du bindest Wechselrichter, Wärmepumpen, Wallboxen, Batteriespeicher und dynamische Stromtarife an - über Modbus, EEBus, REST und diverse proprietäre Protokolle - und baust dafür Abstraktionen, die eine echte Plug-and-Play-Erfahrung möglich machen.
Produkt und Priorisierung: Du denkst wie ein Produktmensch, priorisierst pragmatisch und findest den Kompromiss zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit.
Tech-Leadership: Du setzt unsere technische Vision um und baust perspektivisch das Tech-Team mit auf, als Mentor:in und Vorbild.
Qualifikation
Erfahrung: Du hast mehrere Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung gearbeitet und schon Verantwortung für ein System übernommen, das echte Nutzer im Einsatz hatten.
Tech-Stack: Du kennst Node.js und TypeScript im Backend, Vue und Capacitor im Frontend und hast keine Angst vor Hardware-nahem Arbeiten (Yocto Linux, Embedded). Wenn dir Teile davon fehlen, du dich aber schnell reinarbeitest: erzähl uns, wo du das schon mal gemacht hast.
Schnittstellen: Du hast schon mit REST, Modbus, EEBus oder vergleichbaren Protokollen gearbeitet oder bringst die Bereitschaft mit, dich tief in Geräteprotokolle einzuarbeiten.
Arbeitsweise: Du blühst in schnellen, kollaborativen Iterationen auf, zeigst hohe Eigeninitiative und stellst tiefgreifende Fragen zu dem, was wir tun und wie wir es tun.
Kommunikation: Du vertrittst deine Meinung selbstbewusst, bist offen für andere Ideen und lebst "Disagree and commit".
Motivation: GreenTech, Sicherheit und Datenschutz sind für dich keine Buzzwords.
Standort: Du arbeitest hybrid mit mindestens 3 Tagen pro Woche im Kölner Büro.

Echte Mitinhaberschaft: wettbewerbsfähiges Grundgehalt plus signifikantes Equity (ESOP). Als Founding Engineer profitierst du direkt vom gemeinsamen Erfolg.
Impact statt Ticket-Abarbeiten: Du beendest das fragmentierte App-Chaos der Energiegeräte und bringst die Energiewende in die eigenen vier Wände.
Modernes Büro in Köln. Hier tüfteln wir gemeinsam an der Hardware, die in Deutschland produziert wird.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und großzügige Urlaubsregelung. Wir sind schnell und anspruchsvoll, aber niemand misst hier Anwesenheit.
Neueste Technik: MacBook, Monitore und alles, was du zum Arbeiten brauchst.

Culture Fit: Gespräch mit Noah, unserem CEO. Wir wollen wissen, wie du arbeitest und was du von uns erwartest, und du bekommst ein ehrliches Bild davon, wo wir stehen.
Take-Home-Assignment: eine überschaubare Aufgabe, die du dir in Ruhe ansiehst.
Technical Check: Deep Dive mit Kevin, unserem CTO, rund eine Woche später. Architektur, Trade-offs und die Aufgabe aus Schritt 2.

Important: You must be based in Berlin for this role. We offer flexibility to work from home, but this is not a remote-from-anywhere position.
Hivebuy is a Berlin-based B2B procurement SaaS transforming how companies manage purchasing, approvals, orders, invoices, budgets and suppliers.
We’re building much more than a CRUD application. Our platform combines complex procurement workflows, multi-tenant architecture, ERP and accounting integrations, real-time functionality and increasingly AI-powered workflows.
We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with a strong backend focus to help us build and evolve this platform.
We’re looking for a T-shaped engineer: someone with deep backend expertise who is also comfortable following a feature across the entire stack. You don’t need to be equally strong in Django and Vue, but you should be willing and able to understand, change and ship both.
Our core stack includes Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Elasticsearch, Vue 3, TypeScript and AWS . We run our services on ECS Fargate, manage infrastructure with Terraform, and use Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry and CloudWatch to understand what’s happening in production.
AI coding agents are a normal part of how we develop software. We believe they make strong engineers significantly more effective, but they also make judgment, verification and ownership more important, not less.
Tasks
Own features end-to-end. Understand the problem, challenge requirements when necessary, design the solution, implement it, test it, deploy it and verify that it actually works in production.
Design and build backend services and APIs using Python, Django and Django REST Framework .
Work with PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery and Elasticsearch to build reliable, scalable application and background-processing workflows.
Work across the stack when necessary, implementing and debugging functionality in our Vue 3 + TypeScript frontend.
Build and maintain integrations with external systems such as ERP/accounting platforms, authentication providers, billing systems, Slack and Microsoft Teams.
Work on our growing AI-powered product features and help us integrate LLMs responsibly into production workflows.
Investigate production issues across the complete system, from browser to API, background workers, databases and infrastructure.
Write meaningful automated tests using tools such as pytest, Vitest and Playwright .
Improve performance, reliability, monitoring and deployment safety.
Participate in architecture discussions and make technical decisions that keep the system maintainable as we grow.
Review code and help maintain a high engineering standard across the team.
Identify technical improvements proactively. If you see a bad pattern, flaky test, slow endpoint, missing metric or repetitive manual process, we expect you to improve it or make it visible.
Use AI coding agents as part of your engineering workflow for implementation, investigation, testing, review and understanding unfamiliar parts of the system.
Communicate proactively in our distributed working environment, document important decisions and surface blockers and risks early.
For us, “done” does not mean “PR merged.” Done means the change is running in production, works as intended and has been verified.

Strong professional experience building and operating production systems with Python and Django , ideally Django REST Framework.
Deep understanding of PostgreSQL , including data modelling, migrations, query performance, indexing and diagnosing database-related production issues.
Experience designing and evolving asynchronous and distributed workloads , ideally with Celery and Redis, including retries, idempotency, failure handling and long-running tasks.
Strong understanding of software architecture and system design . You can make pragmatic architectural decisions, explain the trade-offs and evolve existing systems without unnecessary rewrites.

s.h: DataKind is looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer!
s.t:
DataKind is looking for a values-driven, product-focused full stack software engineer who is ready to make a major impact on student graduation rates by building the web application and API layer that powers our education data platform. If you're someone who moves fluidly between frontend and backend, cares about the craft of a well-built data product, and are committed to advancing equity through data, we want to bring you on board!
Location
This is a remote position that can be based anywhere in the U.S. and requires the majority of working hours each day to fall between 8am and 6pm Eastern Standard Time.

Actual salary within these ranges will be based on the candidate's experience and internal salary equity scan of active employee(s) with similar role and experience.
About the Opportunity
DataKind is seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer to build and evolve the UI and API layer of our education data platform. This role owns the software that turns complex educational data into something usable, insightful, and reliable for the institutions we serve. You'll spend most of your time in the web application and API, with regular contributions to the data engineering and infrastructure work that supports it.
Reporting to the VP of Technology, you'll work closely with Data Engineering, Data Science, Product, and Customer Success to ship features that directly affect student outcomes. You'll be a contributing senior technical voice on the team, someone who can take ambiguous product requirements and turn them into shipped, well-architected software.

Product Engineering (60%)
Design, build, and maintain web application front end and the APIs that power it.
Translate product and user requirements, often shaped by direct partner feedback, into clean, maintainable, well-tested code.
Own features end to end: from technical design through implementation, testing, and deployment.
Collaborate with Product and Customer Success to understand how institutional users actually work with our education data platform and use that to inform technical decisions.
Contribute to frontend architecture, component design, and API design standards across the team.
Data Engineering and Infrastructure (25%)
Contribute to data pipeline and integration work that feeds the education data platform, in partnership with the Data Engineering team.
Support infrastructure decisions related to application performance, scalability, and reliability.
Help ensure data flowing into the application layer is validated, well-structured, and secure, including implementation of authentication/authorization (e.g., SSO, OAuth, role-based access control) appropriate for handling sensitive student data.
Collaborate and contribute across DataKind (15%)
Partner with Data Engineering and Data Science to operationalize models and analytics into production-ready product features.
Align your work with DataKind ’s engineering standards, conduct timely code reviews for your peers, and consistently contribute quality technical documentation.
Contribute to the continuous improvement and maintenance of internal tooling, engineering process documentation, and workflow automation.

Required
Deep alignment with DataKind 's mission and values, and demonstrated commitment to educational equity and data-driven social impact
3-5 years of professional full stack software engineering experience, including meaningful ownership of both frontend and backend systems.
Advanced proficiency in a modern JavaScript/TypeScript framework (e.g., React) and backend API development.
Working proficiency in GCP, Python and SQL to support infrastructure and data engineering pipelines.
Experience designing and building RESTful or GraphQL APIs.
Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration, and/or end-to-end) and working in a codebase with CI-enforced test coverage.
Solid understanding of data modeling and how application design intersects with data pipelines.
Proven ability to collaborate across engineering, data science, and product functions.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders.

Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.
Experience with PHP, Laravel, OpenAI API, and Anthropic API.
Experience with Git-based collaborative workflows (e.g., pull requests, code reviews) and CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions).
Experience building or integrating AI-powered features into a product (e.g., LLM integration, recommendation systems, applied ML).
Experience implementing authentication and authorization patterns (e.g., SSO, OAuth, role-based access control) in a production web application.
Experience building dashboards or data visualization tools for varied end users.
Familiarity with education data systems (e.g., SIS, LMS, or student outcome data).
Experience building systems that comply with SOC2 and/or FERPA.
Familiarity with civic tech, social impact, or nonprofit data ecosystems.
About DataKind
At DataKind , we believe in the transformative power of data science and AI to create a more promising future.

Since our founding in 2012, we've been at the forefront of designing scalable, data-driven tools that address some of the world's toughest challenges—ranging from frontline health, humanitarian action, climate and environment, economic opportunity, education, and more.

As both a product innovator and a movement catalyst, we set new standards in the social sector, empowering organizations to harness the full potential of data science and AI while putting communities first.

Flexibility and time off. Enjoy genuine flexibility that goes beyond adjustable hours. We build in shared time off, organization-wide recharge days, bi-weekly meeting-free days, and flexible PTO (with a minimum of 20 vacation days encouraged annually).
Comprehensive Wellness Support. We care for your total wellbeing with 100% employer-paid medical, vision, and dental benefits for employees (72% for dependents), a wellness reimbursement program for the activities and purchases that matter to you, and 12 weeks paid parental leave when you need it most.

Our Purpose
At SentinelOne , we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever.

When you join SentinelOne , your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.
Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.
As a Senior Software Engineer on the Agent Platform team, you will help secure tens of millions of devices across Windows, Linux, and macOS while processing billions of security events every day as part of SentinelOne ’s Endpoint Protection product line.
We are looking for an excellent software engineer with a reliability-first mindset who thrives on solving complex distributed systems challenges in production and turning those learnings into durable platform improvements and long-term engineering ownership.
You’ll help drive customer-critical incident response across the Agent Platform, rapidly build context across multiple platform services, and partner with engineering teams to continuously improve the platform’s reliability, operability, and scalability as a whole.
You will build and evolve the high-throughput, highly available services responsible for policy, configuration, and command distribution to millions of agents worldwide, while contributing to the agent platform protocols that enable other SentinelOne teams to deliver new security capabilities safely and at scale.
This role offers broad technical ownership, the opportunity to work across service boundaries, and the ability to influence the design and reliability of critical platform capabilities used throughout the Agent Platform at SentinelOne . You’ll solve some of the company’s most complex production challenges while helping shape the future of our platform.
What Will You Do?

Drive rapid response to customer-critical incidents by diagnosing, triaging, and resolving complex production issues that span multiple services across the Agent Platform.
Lead systematic root-cause analysis and translate incident learnings into durable reliability, scalability, observability, and operability improvements.
Quickly build a systems-level understanding of unfamiliar services and codebases, collaborating closely with engineering teams to resolve complex cross-service issues.
Design, develop, test, document, deploy, and operate large-scale, high-volume, low-latency distributed systems processing millions of events per second.
Understand, maintain, and continuously improve existing services through refactoring, feature development, and architectural enhancements.
Maintain application stability and data integrity by monitoring key metrics, improving operational visibility, and continuously strengthening the codebase.
Translate business and functional requirements into robust, scalable, and operable technical solutions.
Partner closely with engineering teams across SentinelOne to solve cross-functional problems, influence technical direction, and deliver solutions that scale.
Continuously evaluate and adopt technologies that improve the platform’s scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.
Your Toolkit
Our backend services are primarily developed in Java , with Go and Python also playing important roles.
We use gRPC, REST, GraphQL, and Kafka for service communication.
Our data layer includes Redis, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, ClickHouse , and our own columnar time-series database.
Our services run across multiple AWS and GCP regions on Kubernetes , using Docker, GitHub, and ArgoCD .
We provide engineers with modern AI-powered tools to improve both engineering productivity and software quality.
What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

5+ years of professional backend software engineering experience with deep expertise in at least one of Java, Go, or Python , and the willingness to work across all three as needed.
A reliability-first mindset with a proven ability to solve complex production incidents, perform systematic root-cause analysis, and implement durable engineering solutions that prevent recurrence.
Demonstrated ability to quickly understand unfamiliar distributed systems, navigate large codebases, and troubleshoot complex failures across service boundaries.
Strong hands-on experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, with a deep understanding of failure modes, performance trade-offs, resilience patterns, and operational excellence.
Experience with AWS, GCP , or similar cloud platforms, as well as Docker, Helm, and Kubernetes .
Experience with messaging systems and data platforms such as Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, Cassandra, ClickHouse , or similar technologies.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering teams, Product, Technical Account Managers, and other stakeholders, influence technical direction, and mentor fellow engineers.
A high degree of ownership, autonomy, curiosity, and the ability to drive ambiguous technical problems to successful outcomes.
Experience in an enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity software company is highly desirable.
Why SentinelOne ?
AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

Empower every employee.
At Flip, we have a clear goal: to revolutionize the world for frontline workers and give them a voice. Become a Flip Game Changer and work with an unbeatable team to ensure that all employees, no matter where they work, have access to their company's internal information. If you're ready to make an impact and shape the work lives of millions of people, then you've come to the right place!
Our Mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.
Job Description
Flip is the frontline employee experience platform. Hundreds of thousands of people who do not work at a desk open Flip to reach everything their employer's digital world holds for them and Bosch, REWE and Porsche are a a few of the companies that run it. The hard part is the last mile into a decades-old enterprise IT landscape, and that last mile is this role.
As a Customer Engineer you sit on the edge of the product, inside the customer's environment: their identity stack, their HR systems, their security review, their AI roadmap.

You take a Flip tenant from nothing to hundreds of thousands of live users and you decide how the technical side gets solved, sometimes by designing the integration and enabling the customer's IT to build it, sometimes by building the first version yourself and handing it over.

That includes where our AI goes live: agents in the frontline app, tool access over MCP, and the authentication questions underneath them that nobody has solved yet.
What you can expect
Technical ownership end to end: You own the technical side of enterprise onboardings, from the first architecture conversation to a stable live rollout at scale.
Integrations that make Flip load-bearing: You design and land identity and authentication (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), user provisioning (SCIM), REST APIs and connections into HR and ops systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG.
Advise and enable instead of absorb: You bring the customer's IT, their partners and our external development partners to a solution you would sign off on, and you make sure they can run it without you.
Build where building unblocks: Where building is the fastest way to prove an approach or to unblock a rollout, you build the first version and then hand it over cleanly, with the documentation and the handover conversation that make it stick.
AI where it meets the customer: You lead how agents, MCP-based tool access and agent-to-agent scenarios land at enterprise customers, including the auth and data boundaries that have to hold around them.
Technical authority in the account: You work with customer project management, IT, security, functional departments and works councils, you decide the technical questions, and you feed the gaps you see back into our product and engineering teams. Expect regular travel to customer sites, roughly 10 to 30 percent of your time.

s.h: What you bring to the table
s.t:
Must-haves
Around 3 to 5 (or more) years in IT or tech consulting, customer engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering or SaaS implementation, with real enterprise exposure.
Hands-on experience with enterprise integration and identity: SSO and authentication (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID or comparable), REST APIs and API-based integrations delivered inside real enterprise IT environments.
Customer-facing technical responsibility in enterprise projects, where you made the technical calls together with IT, security and functional departments rather than only coordinating them.
Genuine technical depth without being a full-time production developer: you read code, review a design, debug an integration and build a working prototype.
German at C1 level or above and fluent English.
Nice-to-haves
Provisioning experience (SCIM) and integrations into HR or workforce systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG.
An informed, current view on where agentic AI is heading: MCP, A2A, EMA and the authentication questions underneath them. We are looking for someone who follows the field closely and has an opinion, not for years of experience that cannot exist yet.
Prior work as a Customer Engineer or Forward Deployed Engineer at a product company, rather than in classic consulting only.
Workflow automation tooling (n8n or similar), comfort with logs, metrics and dashboards, or experience with German co-determination and enterprise data protection.

Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices - always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview.
Work-Life-Balance: We don't want you to grow roots to your desk chair. That's why we cover the costs of your E-Gym-Wellpass membership and offer job bike leasing.
Celebrating success: Expect highly motivated and committed people in a relaxed working atmosphere.
Be part of something bigger : You actively shape Flip in your role. Along the way, you are an enabler of the rapid growth process of a young tech company and grow towards your goals, fun is guaranteed.
Happy to be a Flipster: Stay tuned for regular team events and culture days that bring us together as Flipsters.
Working abroad: At Flip you can also work abroad in the European Union. Let's talk about remote work in the interview.
At Flip, everyone is welcome - no matter what gender you identify as or how old you are. Sexual identity , origin, religion, world view and disabilities do not influence your potential job at Flip. The most important thing is that YOU fit in!

We’re Capital on Tap
Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.
Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier.
1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started!
We opened our first Portuguese office in Porto in autumn 2025, and in less than a year it has grown to a team of 50. Lisbon is the next step. We're opening our first office in the city and looking for engineers to join as founding members of the team, helping shape how we build, hire and work here from day one.
The role starts out fully remote. Once our Lisbon office is open, it will move to a hybrid set-up of two days a week on site.

What You’ll Be Doing
We're looking for an Engineering Team Lead to lead one of our product engineering teams here at Capital on Tap.
This is a people-first leadership role. You'll be responsible for the growth, wellbeing, and performance of a team of engineers, while staying technically credible enough to shape direction, remove blockers, and raise the bar on quality. You won't be the best coder in the room you'll be the person who makes the whole room better.
If you're an experienced Team Lead Engineer looking to own a team in a scaling fintech, this role is built for you.
What You'll Own
Your team. Hiring, developing, and retaining engineers. Running 1:1s that actually matter. Spotting who's ready to grow and creating the space for them to do it.
Delivery. Partnering with Product and QA to plan and ship reliably not by micromanaging, but by removing obstacles, managing risk, and keeping the team focused on what matters.
Culture. Setting the tone for how the team communicates, gives feedback, and holds itself accountable. Building psychological safety without sacrificing standards.
Technical credibility. You won't be heads-down in the codebase every day, but you'll understand the trade-offs your team is navigating architecture decisions, technical debt, build vs buy and contribute meaningfully to those conversations.

Leadership first. You've managed engineers before and have a point of view on what good looks like. You know how to have hard conversations, give developmental feedback, and motivate people.
Technical foundation in .NET. Our backend is C#/.NET Core and you'll need enough depth to earn trust with your engineers, review decisions, and spot risks. You don't need to be across every layer of the stack you need to be honest about what you know and curious about what you don't.
Product mindset. You think about engineering in the context of business outcomes, not just technical correctness. You can push back on scope, advocate for quality, and translate between engineering and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfort with ambiguity. Capital on Tap is growing. Priorities shift. We want someone who creates clarity for their team rather than waiting for it.

**Swiss Medical Network** est l'un des groupes de cliniques privées les plus importants de Suisse. Il s'est fixé pour objectif d'offrir des soins médicaux de premier ordre à ses patients suisses et étrangers.

Swiss Medical Network convainc par la haute qualité de ses prestations, un environnement de travail agréable et une équipe de direction expérimentée à l'esprit entrepreneurial. ## Description du poste ##
En tant que **Fullstack Developer (AI & Digital Health)**, vous jouez un rôle moteur dans la transformation numérique de nos cliniques. Vous concevez et développez des solutions logicielles innovantes assistées par l'IA, qui améliorent le parcours du patient tout en soulageant le personnel médical. Vous agissez comme un pont technique entre les exigences médicales et les technologies de pointe, garantissant que nos applications de santé numériques sont sécurisées, évolutives et conviviales.

**Votre domaine d'activité**
* **Développement & Architecture de solutions :** Conception et implémentation d'applications web Fullstack évolutives (Frontend & Backend) pour un usage clinique et administratif.
* **Intégration de l'IA :** Développement et intégration de modèles d'apprentissage automatique (Machine Learning), de LLM (Large Language Models) et de services d'IA déterministes (explainable AI) dans des applications existantes et nouvelles pour soutenir les processus diagnostiques ou administratifs.
* **Données & Interfaces :** Connexion des applications aux systèmes primaires cliniques (KIS/HIS/DPI) en utilisant des standards d'interopérabilité modernes (ex. FHIR, HL7) et garantie d'un échange de données fluide.
* **Security by Design :** Garantie des standards de sécurité les plus élevés et de la conformité à la protection des données (LPD/RGPD) lors du traitement des données sensibles des patients, en étroite coordination avec le délégué à la protection des données.
* **DevOps & Cloud :** Mise en place et maintenance de pipelines CI/CD ainsi que gestion de l'infrastructure Cloud pour l'exploitation des solutions d'IA.
* **Prototyping :** Développement rapide de preuves de concept (PoC) pour évaluer le potentiel des nouvelles technologies d'IA pour le quotidien clinique et les rendre tangibles.
* **Collaboration :** Étroite coopération avec les Data Scientists, les médecins et le personnel soignant afin de créer des solutions centrées sur l'utilisateur ("User Centricity").
**Votre profil**
* **Formation :** Diplôme universitaire en informatique, ingénierie logicielle ou qualification comparable avec un fort accent sur les technologies web modernes.
* **Compétences en développement :** Expérience approfondie dans les frameworks Backend (ex. Python, Node.js, Java) et Frontend (ex. React, Angular, Vue.js) modernes, idéalement sur la Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Looker). Des connaissances en Python sont privilégiées en raison de l'orientation IA.
* **Expertise en IA :** Expérience pratique dans l'intégration de composants IA/ML (ex. API OpenAI, LangChain, Hugging Face, TensorFlow) dans des environnements logiciels productifs.
* **Secteur de la santé :** Une expérience avec les normes du secteur de la santé (FHIR, HL7, DICOM) est un avantage, mais pas obligatoire si vous êtes prêt à vous y former. Une expérience avec le "Software as Medical Device" et les processus de certification correspondants constitue un atout majeur.
* **Méthode de travail :** Un mode de travail autonome, agile (Scrum/Kanban) et orienté solutions. Vous avez une mentalité "Can-Do" et prenez plaisir à résoudre des problèmes complexes par le code.
* **Personnalité :** Esprit d'innovation couplé à une conscience de la qualité. Vous savez rendre des sujets techniques compréhensibles pour des interlocuteurs non techniques.
* **Langues :** De langue maternelle allemande avec un niveau courant/négociation en français (ou inversement) ; de bonnes connaissances en anglais sont requises pour la collaboration au sein de nos équipes linguistiques régionales.
* **Tech-Stack :** Des connaissances en technologies de conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes), plateformes Cloud (Azure/GCP) et gestion de versions (Git) sont prérequis.
## Informations supplémentaires ##
**Notre offre**
* **Innovation :** Nous vous offrons la possibilité de travailler à la pointe de l'innovation médicale et de développer des solutions d'IA qui apportent une véritable plus-value à la vie des patients.
* **Création :** Vous bénéficiez d'une grande marge de manœuvre technique dans un environnement dynamique qui favorise les circuits de décision courts et la pensée entrepreneuriale.

💼 Job Title: Principal Software Engineer
📍 Location: Fully remote within Europe (CET ±2 hours)
⏳ Job Type: Full-time
⭐️ Reports to: Director of Engineering

We are looking for a deeply hands-on Principal Software Engineer to be the most senior technical individual contributor at Hi Rasmus . Reporting to our Director of Engineering, this is a role on our Principal track, a craft career path that sits alongside the management track rather than beneath it.
Where a Lead Software Engineer is the strongest technical contributor within one outcome team, the Principal Software Engineer works across all of them. You will help shape and evolve our platform architecture, strengthen shared technical practices, mentor Senior and Lead Engineers, and take on complex challenges that span teams or domains.
This is not an advisory role. You will work alongside teams in the code, helping solve difficult problems and piloting new tools, patterns, and practices through real work. Your goal is not to become a permanent escalation point, but to leave teams more capable of making strong technical decisions independently.
You lead through technical judgement, architecture, code review, collaboration and example rather than through reporting lines. Software Engineers sit in the outcome teams and report to their Lead Engineer.

You will provide technical guidance and mentorship across teams, while people leadership, performance management, staffing and overall Engineering accountability remain with Lead Engineers and the Director of Engineering. As we scale, we are relying increasingly on AI and automation to improve engineering leverage.

Working in partnership with the Director of Engineering and CTO, you will help translate our company and Engineering direction into sound architecture, modern technical practices, and durable internal capability.

Work alongside outcome teams to solve complex technical problems, particularly those spanning systems, teams, or domains.
Pilot new tools, patterns, and practices through real production work before supporting broader adoption.
Facilitate the architecture forum, bringing Product and other stakeholders into decisions early and establishing a clear process for documenting, communicating, and revisiting those decisions.
Partner with the Director of Engineering, CTO, and Lead Engineers to guide the evolution of our web and mobile platform across Vue 3, Quasar, Capacitor, Node.js, Firebase, Firestore, and Google Cloud Platform.
Evaluate and recommend tooling and framework decisions, including build, buy, adopt, or retire recommendations grounded in real evidence and business needs.
Take on the complex, cross-cutting problems that span teams or that no single team can own, and land them in production.
Establish shared technical standards across code quality, testing, APIs, data modelling, documentation, and system design, building adoption through practical value, review, and example.
Surface technical debt, performance, scalability, and system-health risks early, and partner with Engineering leadership to prioritize the right investments.
Strengthen internal ownership of critical systems, architectural decisions, deployment paths, and operational knowledge through clear documentation, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on collaboration.
Build alignment across teams through the Lead Engineers guild while preserving the ownership and autonomy of individual outcome teams.
Advance responsible AI-assisted development practices and evaluate their impact on quality, speed, reliability, privacy, and security. Help scale what works and thoughtfully retire practices that no longer serve us.
Identify technical risk, performance, and scalability problems before they are urgent, and lead the work to remove them.
Mentor Senior and Lead Engineers through pairing, design review, technical feedback, and shared problem-solving.
Contribute to the engineering career ladder and to levelling and calibration, and act as the technical assessor in engineering hiring, with decisions owned by Lead Engineers and the Director of Engineering.
Partner with the Principal QA Engineer, Product, and DevOps so that quality, testability, and operability are designed in rather than added later.
Contribute to compliance and audit readiness by helping make sure our technical practices hold up to external scrutiny in a regulated healthcare context.

s.h: 🌱 What Success Looks LikeWithin your first 6–12 months
s.t:
Teams are using a shared, practical architecture decision process, with important decisions clearly documented and understood.
Ownership of critical domains and systems is clearer, and the highest-priority cross-team technical risks and debt have actionable plans.
AI-assisted development practices are producing measurable improvements without compromising quality, privacy, security, or reliability.
Senior and Lead Engineers are more confident making complex technical decisions, with fewer issues requiring escalation.
Critical platform and operational knowledge is increasingly shared, documented, and owned internally.

Extensive experience as a Senior, Lead, or Principal Software Engineer, with a track record of delivering complex, production-grade systems.
Deep technical capability that remains current. You can step into a difficult problem, contribute meaningfully in the code, and help carry the solution into production.
Deep proficiency in Vue 3 and Node.js, with strong full-stack understanding.
Strong, practical experience with Domain-Driven Design. You can identify bounded contexts within a complex domain, model them thoughtfully, and protect those boundaries under delivery pressure. Experience applying tactical DDD in code is essential.

¿Qué es?
Es un profesional especializado en el desarrollo, integración y adaptación de sistemas operativos embebidos (como Embedded Linux o RTOS) para ECUs (Unidades de Control Electrónico), con enfoque en la replicación y optimización de un Test OS en plataformas automotrices.
¿Cómo lo hace?
Analiza y porta el Test OS (usado para pruebas, diagnósticos y validación) de vehículos Gen2 a Gen1, adaptando su arquitectura, servicios y flujo de despliegue.
Desarrolla capas de abstracción de software para garantizar la compatibilidad entre el Test OS y el hardware de las ECUs.
Integra funcionalidades clave como diagnósticos (UDS, DoIP), flasheo de firmware, adquisición de datos (logging) y monitoreo de salud en tiempo real.
Automatiza pruebas (SIL, HIL y a nivel vehicular) para validar el comportamiento de las ECUs y los componentes conectados.
Depura problemas entre capas (software, hardware, comunicación) y colabora con equipos multidisciplinarios para cerrar brechas de plataforma.
¿Por qué es crucial?
Su trabajo asegura que los sistemas embebidos en vehículos Gen1 funcionen con la misma robustez y capacidad de prueba que los de Gen2, garantizando calidad, seguridad y cumplimiento de estándares automotrices (ej: ASPICE, MISRA C).

Lenguajes: C (avanzado +5 años), C++ (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años), Python (intermedio 2-5 años), Bash (intermedio 2-5 años).
Sistemas operativos embebidos: Embedded Linux (avanzado +5 años), RTOS (avanzado +5 años).
Protocolos de comunicación: CAN, CAN FD, UDS (avanzado +5 años), DoIP, Automotive Ethernet (intermedio 2-5 años).
Herramientas: Vector CANoe/CANalyzer/CANape (avanzado +5 años), GDB, JTAG (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años).
Pruebas automatizadas: GoogleTest, pytest (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años), SIL, HIL (avanzado +5 años).
CI/CD y control de versiones: Git (avanzado +5 años), Jenkins, GitLab CI (intermedio/avanzado 3-5+ años).
Firmware para ECUs: Integración, flasheo, diagnósticos (DIDs, DTCs) (avanzado +5 años).
